oil.when: 2007–2009 with the message center and RESET control
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, use the message center controls to enter SYSTEM CHECK and step through it until the display shows HOLD RESET IF NEW OIL.
Press and hold the RESET control for more than two seconds. The display shows OIL LIFE SET TO 100%.
Only if you want a shorter interval: press and release RESET again; each press lowers the starting value.
oil.note: A 100% starting value equals about 7,500 miles or six months. Checked in the 2007 and 2009 Explorer Sport Trac owner's guides.
